text:
anya: Heads-up — proposing a small change to routing policy schema: add per-tier region overrides + a soft quota grace window that triggers variant fallback after N seconds. Need quick sync before I open the console PR.

ben: can you paste a sample policy? curious how we model grace window vs hard quota.

anya: sure, gist below — super small example for pro-tier, eu override and soft action: 

```json
{
  "tier": "pro",
  "region_overrides": {
    "eu-west-1": {
      "preferred_variant": "redwood-7b-q4",
      "fallback_order": ["redwood-7b-q4", "redwood-7b", "small-llm"]
    }
  },
  "quota": {
    "monthly": 10000000,
    "soft_window_seconds": 30,
    "soft_action": "fallback_variant"
  }
}
```

chloe: telemetry notes — please emit these events/tags: route_decision (variant, reason), fallback_reason, fallback_latency_ms, tokens_charged_before_fallback. Also histogram fallback_rate_by_tier. Product wants to chart by region+tier.

samir: console/rollout UX: recommend a preview mode for the policy editor that shows sample routing decisions for a tenant (dry-run). Also need a pin/exception toggle for enterprise tenants so we don't apply region overrides to VIPs during rollouts.

luis: ops caveat — free tier often has burst credits. soft_window alone would trigger fallback for single-request spikes. We should add an op_exempt list or per-tenant overrides (small table) to avoid surprise degradations. Also: is enforcement in API gateway or router runtime?

ben: important — billing concern: we must ensure tokens charged reflect actual served variant. If router attempts variant A and falls back to B, charge only B. Router must mark the attempt as 'fallback_attempt' and runtime should skip billing for the failed attempt.

eng-bot: policy-linter: policy schema v2 failed CI — missing required field 'fallback_ttl_ms'. See CI run: https://ci.internal/redwood/pipeline/4823 :eyes:

anya: thanks — adding fallback_ttl_ms (default 5000ms) and fallback_latency_ms telemetry. Will push schema update + console preview in next PR.

samir: can we expose an audit trail in the console showing the decision chain for a tenant for last 24h? product wants per-tenant decisions + sample requests that triggered fallback. Privacy note: for enterprise, we should offer a redact option.

chloe: agree — add a do-not-sample flag for enterprise so we still emit aggregate metrics but not raw request samples. We'll also tag fallback events with tenant_plan and region.

luis: I'll wire quota enforcement to billing service. Plan: enforce soft_window in router (trigger fallback) and send an enforcement webhook to billing; billing will apply deducts. Use idempotency keys on billing calls to avoid double charges.

anya: nice. For automation: if fallback_rate_by_tier > 5% in any region for pro, auto-rollback the policy to previous version. Add alert to SRE dashboard. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: canary-deploy: routing-service v2.4.0 started canary in us-west-2 (10%).

ben: watching metrics. If we see spike in fallback_latency_ms or billing anomalies raise pager. :eyes:

anya: I will open the schema + console PRs and tag @samir for UX review. Thanks all.
